title: Fix missing table permissions on Stale Check action in Check Management Subscriber
summary: Added missing table permissions to the Check Management Subscriber codeunit to allow the Stale Check action to properly modify bank account and customer/vendor ledger entries without permission errors.
key_points: Stale Check action was failing due to missing Modify permissions on ledger tables
Added Permissions property to Check Management Subscriber codeunit
Grants read-modify permissions on Bank Account Ledger Entry, Check Ledger Entry, Customer Ledger Entry, and Vendor Ledger Entry
Resolves license permission errors during stale check operations
